fact: The National Broadband Strategy 2019-2023, dated September 2020, targets broadband penetration rising from 4.5% to 35% and speed from 1 to 5 Mbps by 2023, with 25 initiatives costed at MWK558 billion.
title: National Broadband Strategy 2019 - 2023
publisher: Ministry of Information, Government of Malawi
